questions.q:
Find out which part has an error and mark it as your answer. If there is no error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

 I bought (A)/some gold pretty Arabian ornaments (B)/at the flea market. (C)No error (D)
questions.s:
• Part B has an error, hence, the correct answer is option 2.
  • When there are multiple adjectives used to describe an object, the following order must be used.
    • Quantity or number
    • Quality or opinion
    • Size
    • Age
    • Shape
    • Colour
    • A proper adjective like nationality, material etc.
  • Hence, the correct order must be pretty Arabian gold

Correct Sentence:

I bought some pretty Arabian gold ornaments at the flea market.

because we did not
want to rely on others.
questions.s: Use "as much work as possible" instead of "much more than work as possible.”

questions.q:
The following sentence has been divided into four segments. Identify the segment that contains an error.

This smartphone is / superior than / the model I had been /using previously.

[Stenographer Grade C and D Examination 2024]
questions.s:
The correct answer is: "superior than"


"Superior" is an adjective that does not take "than" after it.


Instead, it is followed by "to" ("superior to").

She is as beautiful as a peacock in the blue satin saree.

questions.q: Mr. Bansal is the more methodical person in our office staff. (SSC CPO 2020 Tier-II 8 Nov 2021)
questions.s:

questions.q:
Choose the correct form of adjective for the given sentence:
She is very _______; you never know what she is going to do next.
questions.s:
The sentence describes someone whose actions cannot be guessed and who may do anything next. The adjective that expresses this quality is:
unpredictable= not possible to know what she will do next

questions.q: The London-based Brodsky / Quartet, meanwhile, is one of / the world's leading string quartet. (SSC CHSL Tier-01 16/03/23)
questions.s: The phrase "one of the" must be followed by a plural noun. It should be 'quartets'.

questions.q:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don't find any error, mark 'No error' as your answer.


The project was completed / more quicker / than expected.

[CHSL TIER -I 2024]
questions.s:
The correct answer is: more quicker.

"Quicker" is already a comparative form of "quick," so we don't need to use "more" before it.

Correct sentence: The project was completed quicker than expected.

questions.q: (a) Whole the chapter /(b) is full of printing errors which are the outcome /(c) of the proof reader’s carelessness. (d) No error
We enjoyed watching the sunset from the more western side of the island.
o: We enjoyed watching the
sunset from the more
western side of the island
questions.s:
These adjectives Top, topmost, northern, northernmost, southern, southernmost, eastern, easternmost, western, westernmost, etc. are used in only positive and superlative degrees and not in comparative degrees. Therefore, "more Western" is incorrect.

The corrected sentence would be: "We enjoyed watching the sunset from the western side of the island."
